rationale.edition: All 10 changed paths are under web/src/ (Vue components/composables) and tests/ui-testing/ (Playwright specs + page objects) — open-source repo locations with no enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ paths and no ENT keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR) in paths or symbols, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: No skip marker present: the trigger comment and feature hint are both empty and no tests-added label was passed. The change alters user-facing dashboard rendering (off-screen panels now lazy-mount), so it is not docs/CI-only and is not skipped.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: RenderDashboardCharts.vue now renders a lightweight placeholder for off-screen panels and mounts the real panel only when it nears the viewport, changing scroll/visibility behavior, panel-level variable loading, and print/forceLoad mounting — a user-facing UI flow that needs verification.
rationale.area: The bulk of UI changes live in web/src/views/Dashboards/, web/src/components/dashboards/, and web/src/composables/dashboard/, and the changed E2E spec sits in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/, so Dashboards is the correct area.
rationale.group: The changed spec dashboard-variables-panel-level.spec.js already belongs to the Dashboards-Variables shard, but lazy panel mounting is a core rendering behavior affecting every panel (not just variables), so the new spec joins Dashboards-Core, which holds general dashboard behavior specs such as dashboard.spec.js and dashboard2.spec.js.
rationale.existing_tests: One E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ is changed in the diff: dashboard-variables-panel-level.spec.js. It was adapted to the new lazy-mounting behavior (grid-stack-item locators) but only covers panel-level variables, not the broader off-screen-placeholder / scroll-to-mount / print-mode behavior. The .spec.ts changes are Vitest unit tests and do not count as E2E coverage.
